name: WebPageFonts
description: A collection of WebPageFont objects that describe the proportional font, proportional font size, fixed-width font, and fixed-width font size used when documents are saved as webpages. You can specify a different set of webpage font properties for each available character set.
remarks: The WebPageFonts collection contains one WebPageFont object for each character set.
example:
Dim myFont As WebPageFont
Set myFont = _
 Application.DefaultWebOptions.Fonts.Item_
 (msoCharacterSetEnglishWesternEuropeanOtherLatinScript)

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the WebPageFonts object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the WebPageFonts object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the WebPageFonts object. Read-only.

properties.name: Item
properties.description: Gets a WebPageFont object from the WebPageFonts collection for a particular value of MsoCharacterSet. Read-only.
